_about: Real registry stop reasons, each verdict judged by hand. check_text_readers.py fails the build if any of them changes. Add every stop reason that was ever shown wrongly, with the verdict it should have had.

cases.why_stopped: Study was prematurely stopped due to sponsor decision (stage 2 efficacy criteria not met); not due to safety concerns.
cases.evidence_includes: efficacy criteria not met in this trial

cases.why_stopped: The study was terminated because sufficient data had been collected to meet the objectives of the development program. No new or unexpected safety findings were identified, and the decision to terminate was not related to participant safety.
The research was terminated voluntarily due to changes in the company's business strategy regarding the development of BGB-24714, rather than any safety issues.
Study terminated by Sponsor due to absence of significant safety findings.
There was a change in the Sponsor's research strategy; safety concerns were not a factor.
Decision to discontinue the study based on broader development and strategic prioritisation. The Sponsor concludes there is no benefit-risk impact on the BO42203 study.
The study was terminated on August 6, 2012, because 2 large Phase 3 studies showed no clinical benefit. This decision was not based on any new safety concerns.
Study terminated on 15DEC2016 due to study A8241021 showing no significant difference on primary endpoint between PF-02545920 \& placebo. No safety concerns.
Amgen discontinued the development of AMG706 because 20050201 did not meet its primary objective.

In December 2023, Novartis decided to terminate the sabatolimab clinical development program early after Phase II (MDS1) and Phase III (MDS2) studies failed to meet their primary objectives. The termination was not due to safety concerns.
Terminated by sponsor due to low drug bioavailability; no safety concerns were noted.
Study early terminated due to lack of effect (did not meet primary/ secondary endpoints). This decision was not linked to safety concerns
Terminated early due to a lack of efficacy.
Trial was terminated by sponsor due to lack of efficacy.
Study did not meet its primary efficacy endpoint.
Study SPR001-203 did not meet its primary and secondary endpoints therefore Spruce Biosciences has decided to terminate the study
EMD Serono recommendation based on three other studies that failed to show benefit for bintrafusp alfa

The study was terminated early due to the halt of NIS793 treatment and urgent safety measures issued in July and August 2023, respectively, as continued evaluation of Standard of Care alone will not support the trial's purpose.
Study was closed after one treatment related death.

Based on recommendations by an external Independent data Monitoring Committee (IDMC), Sponsor decided to discontinue this clinical study due to a low likelihood of achieving superiority in the efficacy endpoints versus standard of care.
Study closed to accrual due to the worsening risk: benefit ratio for participants receiving bintrafusp alfa (M7824).
The study was prematurely discontinued by the sponsor due to probability of success which was too low to justify the continuation of recruitment.
Due to a Dose Limiting Toxicity in another sister trial with same technology.
Slow enrollment due to subjects not meeting inclusion/exclusion criteria
Following recommendation of the external Data Monitoring Committee, after it reviewed the results of a planned interim futility analysis.
cases.evidence_excludes: cites evidence from outside this trial

cases.why_stopped: In Part A of CR845-310601, oral difelikefalin did not demonstrate a meaningful clinical benefit at any dose compared to placebo. The drug was generally well tolerated with a safety profile similar to prior trials.
Sponsor voluntarily decided to terminate trial due to increased MS disease activity in atacicept arms as compared to placebo during a routine IDMC review.

In line with the study protocol, due to slow recruitment, a futility analysis has been performed in the first quarter of 2025 by an independent statistician. The result of the analysis was restricted to a "no-go".
Clinical study terminated due to preclinical safety findings in non-human primates.

The Sponsor decided to terminate the study after it did not meet the primary efficacy endpoint at final analysis. The safety profile was consistent with prior studies, and no safety concerns were raised by the Data and Safety Monitoring Board.
The study was terminated prematurely by the Sponsor due to observation of dose-limiting adverse events meeting the protocol-defined stopping criteria.
The early termination is due to the results obtained from the sister study, SAPPHIRE (CLS1003-301), which did not meet the 8-week primary efficacy endpoint.
The safety committee found no safety issues but recommended halting the study based on a lack of efficacy in a similar trial. The sponsor terminated the trial.
A Phase 3 study recently reported and demonstrated that the dose of otelixizumab in OTX113390 is not effective.
